dataset_name: NEXUS Technologies — NODUS Stage 7A Company Foundation
description: Fictional, normal-operating enterprise foundation; no scenario labels or findings.

file_inventory.description: Top-level manifest metadata object rather than an entity collection

schema_conventions.collection_wrapper: Named top-level arrays for entity files
schema_conventions.id_format: Canonical company ID is nexus; all other record IDs have globally unique NEX- prefixes. References use stable IDs, never nested entities.
schema_conventions.timestamps: UTC ISO 8601 strings with Z; reference_date is an ISO 8601 calendar date
schema_conventions.foreign_keys: Fields ending in _id or _ids are references except stable record id and company_key
schema_conventions.optional_values: Use explicit null for absent owning_project_id or effective_to
schema_conventions.relationship_direction: For declared_dependencies, source_service_id is the dependent/consumer; target_service_id is the provider/upstream requirement. For event feeds, the consuming service depends on the declared event publisher.
schema_conventions.owner_model: Primary and backup service owners are repeated as IDs for catalog usability and mirrored in normalized service_owner_assignments
schema_conventions.permission_model: Membership/project assignment establishes eligibility only. Confidential resources require explicit resource grants in later stages. Demo tokens are non-secret selectors, not auth credentials.

import_notes: Resolve the teams.json and people.json lead/member foreign-key cycle via deferred FK checks or a second relationship pass.
No database import, migration, schema DDL, NODUS authorization behavior, or agent workflow is provided.
Source-declared dependencies are catalog claims, not inferred or verified NODUS findings.
